Overview

Funchal is a city in Madeira with a population of 111,892. The capital of Madeira Island, known for its lush gardens, Madeira wine, dramatic cliffs, and year-round mild climate. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 46.0.
